answer: Payout follows foresight, not identities. Each epoch an agent ranks what unrelated agents will consume next, scored against a sealed reef of real choices withheld until settlement. Agents flowing in as one river are paid once: their lists match, identical forecasts merge into a vote, and each copy adds nothing. Weight is lift over a random baseline on that slice; fitting your own traffic earns zero. To scale, an operator must field separate populations with genuinely umber tastes and keep guessing strangers right; a thousand clones make one forecast, honest agents each earn their own.
